source: Mafia Universe role database (names and type tags)

roles.name: Ability Thief
roles.description: Each night, target a player. If they have an active ability, you learn it and may use it yourself on a later night.

roles.name: Absentee Voter
roles.description: You may submit your vote privately to the host instead of in the thread; it still counts toward the lynch.

roles.name: Absorber
roles.description: When a player with an ability dies, you may absorb it and use it from then on.

roles.name: Actor
roles.description: Each day, you may cast your vote as if you were another player of your choice. Ask the host for exact rules.

roles.name: Actress
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. You learn their role, and if you die you will appear to be that role.

roles.name: Addictive Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn their alignment. You must investigate every night, or lose your power.

roles.name: Adrenalin Junkie
roles.description: If you are attacked at night, you survive until the end of the following day, then die.

roles.name: Alarmist
roles.description: Once per game, during the night, you may raise an alarm that forces the next day to start with an announcement chosen by the host.

roles.name: Alert Townie
roles.description: You are told whenever someone targets you at night, but not who it was.

roles.name: Alien
roles.description: Each night, abduct a player. They cannot act and cannot be targeted that night.

roles.name: Alignment Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate one player and learn their alignment.

roles.name: Ambulance Driver
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. If they die that night, you learn who visited them.

roles.name: Amnesiac
roles.description: You have no role of your own. Once during the game, choose a dead player and take their role (and alignment, unless the host says otherwise).

roles.name: Amnesiac Cop
roles.description: You investigate a player each night, but you only learn the results once a linked event happens (the host will tell you when).

roles.name: Amplifier
roles.description: Each night, amplify a player's ability: their action that night is stronger or has an extra effect, as the host describes.

roles.name: Anarchist
roles.description: You are a third-party killer who wins by causing chaos. Each night you may kill a player.

roles.name: Ancient
roles.description: You are hard to kill: the first time you would die at night, you survive.

roles.name: Anti-Doctor
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. If a Doctor protects them, the protection fails and they die from your attack.

roles.name: Apportioner
roles.description: Each night, choose two players. Protection given to one is shared with the other.

roles.name: Architect
roles.description: Each night, choose two players. They share a private chat the next night.

roles.name: Armorsmith
roles.description: Each night, give a player a vest that protects them from one kill.

roles.name: Arms Dealer
roles.description: Each night, give a player a gun. Guns may be used once to shoot someone during the day or night.

roles.name: Arsonist
roles.description: Each night, either douse a player in gasoline or ignite: igniting kills everyone you have doused. You win when you are the last one standing.

roles.name: Ascetic
roles.description: Non-killing actions targeting you have no effect on you.

roles.name: Asceticiser
roles.description: Each night, make a player ascetic: non-killing actions on them fail that night.

roles.name: Asshole
roles.description: No one can protect you, and you cannot be targeted by friendly actions.

roles.name: Associate
roles.description: You appear as a different alignment or role to investigations, as the host describes.

roles.name: Astronomer
roles.description: Once per game, cause an extra night phase to happen immediately after the day.

roles.name: Asylum Doctor
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. They are protected from kills but also blocked from acting.

roles.name: Atheist
roles.description: Third party. You win if no religious role (Priest, Cult, etc.) wins, as the host describes.

roles.name: Attention Seeker
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. All actions aimed at them are redirected to you.

roles.name: Avenger
roles.description: If a chosen player dies, you may kill a player in revenge.

roles.name: Avoider
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. If they target you, their action fails.

roles.name: Babysitter
roles.description: Each night, protect a player. If you die, the player you are watching dies too.

roles.name: Backup
roles.description: You are the backup for a specific role. If that role dies, you inherit it.

roles.name: Baker
roles.description: Each night, give a player bread. Bread lets them use their ability an extra time.

roles.name: Bartender
roles.description: Each night, serve a player a drink: they are roleblocked or confused (their action may fail or have a random target).

roles.name: Beguiler
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. Anyone who targets you is redirected to them.

roles.name: Berserker
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. You kill them and anyone who visits them.

roles.name: BFF
roles.description: You are linked to another player. You know each other's roles and, if one of you dies, the other loses their power.

roles.name: Big Brother
roles.description: Each night, you learn every action that was performed, but not who did them.

roles.name: Black Goo
roles.description: When a player targets you, they become a Goo and join your side.

roles.name: Black Hat
roles.description: Once per game, reveal the roles of everyone who targeted a chosen player that night.

roles.name: Blackjack
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. They lose their role and become a vanilla version of their alignment.

roles.name: Blob
roles.description: Third party. Each night, absorb a player into the Blob. You win when everyone left alive is part of the Blob.

roles.name: Bodyguard
roles.description: Each night, guard one player. If they are attacked, you die in their place.

roles.name: Bodyguard Boss
roles.description: Each night, assign members of your team to guard players; they die in place of whoever they guard.

roles.name: Bodyguard Jailkeeper
roles.description: Each night, jail a player: they are protected and cannot act. If they are attacked, you die in their place.

roles.name: Bomb
roles.description: If you are killed at night, your killer dies too.

roles.name: Bomb Defuser
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. If they are a Bomb or carry a bomb, it is defused.

roles.name: Boogeyman
roles.description: Third party. Each night, scare a player: they cannot act. Kill your targets to complete your mission.

roles.name: Bounty Hunter
roles.description: Third party. You are told a target. You win if they are dead by the end of the game; you may kill at night.

roles.name: Brainshocker
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. Their action is redirected to a random target.

roles.name: Bulletproof
roles.description: You survive night kills.

roles.name: Bulletproof Avoider
roles.description: You are bulletproof against one kind of attacker, as the host describes.

roles.name: Bumbling Cop
roles.description: You investigate a player each night, but sometimes your investigation kills them by mistake.

roles.name: Burglar
roles.description: Each night, steal an item or ability from a player.

roles.name: Bus Driver
roles.description: Each night, pick two players. Every action aimed at one hits the other instead.

roles.name: Businessman
roles.description: Each night, give a player a business deal: they gain an extra use of their ability.

roles.name: Bystander
roles.description: You have no ability. You appear as a power role to investigations.

roles.name: Cannibal
roles.description: Third party. Each night, eat a player: they die and you gain their ability.

roles.name: Cannibal Baker
roles.description: Each night, give a player bread. Bread from you may kill them instead of helping.

roles.name: Cannoneer
roles.description: When you die, a cannon fires: a random player dies too.

roles.name: Captain
roles.description: Each night, give a player orders: they must target a player you choose.

roles.name: Caroler
roles.description: Each night, sing to a player: they learn some information you choose (true or false).

roles.name: Chief of Police
roles.description: You know who the Cops are, and you receive copies of their results.

roles.name: Child Murderer
roles.description: You may kill a player at night. If you are lynched, the town loses its next day's vote.

roles.name: Claim Vigilante
roles.description: Each day, name a player and a role. If they are that role, they die.

roles.name: Clairvoyant
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn one piece of information about their role.

roles.name: Clockmaker
roles.description: Third party. Set a clock on a player; when it runs out, they die.

roles.name: Colorblind Cop
roles.description: You investigate alignment, but can't tell some alignments apart (e.g. Mafia from third parties).

roles.name: Command Based Robot
roles.description: You follow commands from the host or another player, gaining abilities as instructed.

roles.name: Communication Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn whether they are in a private chat (Mafia, Masons, Lovers...).

roles.name: Communist
roles.description: Third party. You win when every living player has the same role (everyone is equal).

roles.name: Commuter
roles.description: Each night you may leave town; all actions targeting you fail.

roles.name: Companion
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. You visit them and protect them; actions aimed at you go to them.

roles.name: Confidant
roles.description: You may share a private message with one player each night.

roles.name: Confirmation Cop
roles.description: Each night, name a player and a role. You learn whether that player is that role.

roles.name: Consigliere
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn their role. You work with the Mafia.

roles.name: Conspiracy Theorist
roles.description: Each night, investigate a group of players and learn whether any of them are scum.

roles.name: Converter
roles.description: Each night, convert a player to your alignment.

roles.name: Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate one player and learn their alignment.

roles.name: Cop Invalidator
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. Investigations on them fail that night.

roles.name: Copycat
roles.description: Each night, choose a player and copy their action onto a target of your choice.

roles.name: Coroner
roles.description: Each night, examine a dead player and learn details about their death.

roles.name: CPR Doctor
roles.description: Each night, protect a player. If no one attacks them, your treatment kills them instead.

roles.name: Crazy Old Man
roles.description: You have no ability and believe you have one; your results are made up.

roles.name: Creepy Girl
roles.description: Third party. You hold a doll; give it to a player. You win if the doll's holder dies or is alive at the end, as the host describes.

roles.name: Crippler
roles.description: Each night, cripple a player: they permanently lose their ability.

roles.name: Cult Leader
roles.description: Third party. Each night, try to recruit a player into your Cult.

roles.name: Cultist
roles.description: Member of the Cult. You win with your Cult.

roles.name: Cupid
roles.description: On the first night, choose two players to become Lovers. If one dies, the other dies too.

roles.name: Cycle Doctor
roles.description: You protect players in a set order each night, as the host describes.

roles.name: Dealmaker
roles.description: Each night, offer a player a deal: you swap a piece of information or an effect, as the host describes.

roles.name: Death Miller
roles.description: You are Town, but when you die you are revealed as Mafia.

roles.name: Death Tailor
roles.description: Each night, choose a player and a role. If they die, they are revealed as that role.

roles.name: Deathproof
roles.description: You cannot die at night by any means.

roles.name: Deceiver
roles.description: When you die, you are revealed as a role of your choosing.

roles.name: Decoy
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. Anyone who targets them is told they targeted you instead, or vice versa, as the host describes.

roles.name: Deflector
roles.description: Each night, choose two players. Kills aimed at the first are moved to the second.

roles.name: Delayed Vigilante
roles.description: Each night, shoot a player. They die at the end of the following night, not immediately.

roles.name: Deprogrammer
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. If they were converted or recruited, they return to their original side.

roles.name: Deputy
roles.description: You assist the Sheriff or Cop: if they die, you take over their investigations.

roles.name: Desperado
roles.description: You may shoot a player at night. If they are Town, you die instead.

roles.name: Deva
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. All actions on them fail and they cannot act.

roles.name: Disguiser
roles.description: Each night, choose a player to disguise as. If they die, you take their role reveal and they appear as you.

roles.name: DNA Analyst
roles.description: Each night, examine a dead player and learn who killed them.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.description: Each night, protect one player from night kills.

roles.name: Doctor Boom
roles.description: You protect a player each night; if they are attacked, the attacker dies in an explosion.

roles.name: Don
roles.description: You lead the Mafia. While you are alive, your team has extra power, as the host describes.

roles.name: Doppelgänger
roles.description: You are linked to another player and copy their role and alignment.

roles.name: Double Agent
roles.description: Third party. You appear to be part of one faction but win only if you outlast everyone else.

roles.name: Doublevoter
roles.description: Your vote counts twice.

roles.name: Dreamer
roles.description: Each night you have a dream: you learn a list of players, at least one of whom is (or isn't) scum.

roles.name: Duelist
roles.description: Once per game, challenge a player to a duel during the day. One of you dies, decided by the host.

roles.name: Duke
roles.description: Your vote has extra weight, and you can affect how everyone votes, as the host describes.

roles.name: Duplicate
roles.description: Choose a player once. You become a copy of their role.

roles.name: Electrician
roles.description: You are told when the power goes out (actions fail) or comes back, as the host describes.

roles.name: Electromaniac
roles.description: Each night, charge a player. If two charged players visit each other, both die.

roles.name: Emissary
roles.description: You learn which faction a player belongs to when they target you.

roles.name: Enabler
roles.description: Your teammates' abilities only work while you are alive.

roles.name: Enchantress
roles.description: Each night, enchant a player and learn their role.

roles.name: Encryptor
roles.description: Your team's private chat cannot be read or intercepted by any role.

roles.name: Escape Artist
roles.description: If you are lynched, you escape: you survive, but your role is revealed.

roles.name: Evangelistic Townie
roles.description: You are Town but appear as a Cult member to investigations.

roles.name: Evil Mastermind
roles.description: Third party. You command a minion; you win if you and your minion outlast everyone.

roles.name: Evil Minion
roles.description: Third party. You serve the Evil Mastermind and win with them; you may kill on their orders.

roles.name: Executioner B
roles.description: You may kill a player during the day, or carry out a lynch yourself, as the host describes.

roles.name: Fabricator
roles.description: Each night, give a player a fake item that looks real but does nothing.

roles.name: Faith Healer
roles.description: Each night, protect a player from night kills. Your protection only works some of the time.

roles.name: False Inventor
roles.description: You hand out items that do not work, but appear to.

roles.name: Fat Townie
roles.description: It takes two kills to kill you at night.

roles.name: FBI Agent
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn whether they are in a faction.

roles.name: Fiddler
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. Investigations on them return confused or random results.

roles.name: Firearms Inspector
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn whether they have a gun or killing ability.

roles.name: Firefighter
roles.description: Each night, protect a player from fire (Arsonist ignition) or clean off gasoline.

roles.name: Fisherman
roles.description: Each night, cast a line for a random effect or item, as the host describes.

roles.name: Fixer
roles.description: Each night, fix a player: undo an effect placed on them (douse, poison, frame, etc.).

roles.name: Flavor Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn their character/flavor name rather than their role.

roles.name: Fog
roles.description: Once per game, cover the town in fog: investigations fail that night.

roles.name: Follower
roles.description: Each night, follow a player and learn what kind of action they performed.

roles.name: Forensic Investigator
roles.description: Each night, examine a dead player and learn who visited them on the night they died.

roles.name: Forensic Scientist
roles.description: When a player dies, everyone learns how they died.

roles.name: Forger
roles.description: Choose a player; if they die, their role is revealed as one of your choosing.

roles.name: Forgetful Townie
roles.description: You are a Townie who sometimes forgets what you learned; the host may hide information from you.

roles.name: Framer
roles.description: Each night, frame a player so they appear guilty to investigations that night.

roles.name: Freelancer
roles.description: Third party. You have a mission given by the host; complete it to win.

roles.name: Freezer
roles.description: Each night, freeze a player: they cannot act or be targeted.

roles.name: Friendly Neighbor
roles.description: Each night, reveal yourself as Town to a player you pick.

roles.name: Friendly Neighborizer
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. They become a Friendly Neighbor and can confirm themselves to someone.

roles.name: Frontrunner
roles.description: Third party. You win if you are the player with the most votes at the end of a day, as the host describes.

roles.name: Fruit Vendor
roles.description: Each night, give a player fruit. It does nothing, but they are told they received it.

roles.name: Gallis
roles.description: Your vote counts for more the closer the day is to ending, as the host describes.

roles.name: Gambler
roles.description: Each night, make a bet with the host. Win, and you gain a power; lose, and you lose one.

roles.name: Ghost
roles.description: When you die, you can still haunt: each night you may learn information about a player.

roles.name: Gladiator
roles.description: During the day, you can challenge a player; votes decide which of you is lynched.

roles.name: Godfather
roles.description: The Mafia leader. You appear innocent to alignment investigations.

roles.name: Governor
roles.description: Can overturn or force a lynch, typically once per game.

roles.name: Gramps
roles.description: You are an old man who kills anyone who visits you at night, and learns their role.

roles.name: Gravedigger
roles.description: You may dig up a dead player's role; you appear as a different role to investigations.

roles.name: Great Teacher
roles.description: Each night, teach a player: they gain a new ability or improve theirs.

roles.name: Green Goo
roles.description: When a player targets you, they become Green Goo.

roles.name: Guardian Angel
roles.description: Third party. You are assigned someone to protect. You win if they survive to the end.

roles.name: Gunsmith
roles.description: Each night, give a player a gun they can use to shoot someone.

roles.name: Hacker
roles.description: Each night, hack a player and learn their messages or their role.

roles.name: Hammerer
roles.description: Your vote ends the day immediately when it reaches a lynch.

roles.name: Hated
roles.description: It takes one fewer vote than normal to lynch you.

roles.name: Healer
roles.description: Each night, protect one player from night kills.

roles.name: Hero
roles.description: If a player you are guarding is attacked, you kill the attacker.

roles.name: Hider
roles.description: Hide behind a player at night. If they die, you die too.

roles.name: Hippie
roles.description: You cannot be converted, and peace follows you (killing actions near you may fail).

roles.name: Hirsute Townie
roles.description: You are Town but appear as a Werewolf to investigations.

roles.name: Hitman
roles.description: You carry out a kill for your team on a target someone else picks.

roles.name: Hobo
roles.description: Each night, sleep at a player's house. You learn who visited them.

roles.name: Hollow Man
roles.description: You are an empty shell with no role; if investigated, you show nothing.

roles.name: Hoodlum
roles.description: Third party. You are given targets; you win if they are dead at the end of the game.

roles.name: Hot Potato
roles.description: Each night, pass the potato to a player. Whoever holds it at a set time dies.

roles.name: Hunter
roles.description: When you die, you may take someone with you.

roles.name: Hypnotist
roles.description: Each night, hypnotize a player: they learn false information you choose.

roles.name: Hypochondriac
roles.description: You believe you are sick: you are told you were attacked when you were not.

roles.name: Illusionist
roles.description: Each night, kill a player and make it look like someone else did it, or make your kill appear as a different cause.

roles.name: Immunizer
roles.description: Each night, immunize a player against conversion, poison or infection.

roles.name: Inactivity Vigilante
roles.description: You may kill players who have been inactive, as the host's rules describe.

roles.name: Indecisive Voter
roles.description: Your vote only counts if you have not changed it during the day.

roles.name: Innocence Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn only whether they are innocent (a guilty result shows nothing).

roles.name: Innocent Child
roles.description: Once per game, reveal yourself: the host confirms you as Town to everyone.

roles.name: Inquisitor
roles.description: Third party. Each night, accuse a player: if they are a certain role, they die or are converted.

roles.name: Insane Cop
roles.description: Investigates alignment, but every result is the opposite of the truth. You are not told this.

roles.name: Insane Doctor
roles.description: You think you're a Doctor, but your protection may kill the player instead.

roles.name: Insomniac
roles.description: You stay awake at night: you learn whether anyone visited you.

roles.name: Interceptor
roles.description: Each night, intercept a player's visitors: the first person to visit them is killed.

roles.name: Inventor
roles.description: Each night, give a player an item you invented (gun, vest, etc., as the host lists).

roles.name: ITA Doctor
roles.description: In ITA (in-thread attack) games, you can protect players from in-thread shots.

roles.name: ITA Master
roles.description: In ITA games, your in-thread shots are stronger or more frequent.

roles.name: ITA Nerfer
roles.description: In ITA games, you reduce another player's chance of hitting with in-thread shots.

roles.name: ITA Sniper
roles.description: In ITA games, your in-thread shots always hit.

roles.name: ITA Trainer
roles.description: In ITA games, you improve another player's in-thread shot chance.

roles.name: Item Thief
roles.description: Each night, steal an item from a player.

roles.name: Jack of All Trades
roles.description: You have several one-shot abilities (e.g. one kill, one protect, one investigation).

roles.name: Jailkeeper
roles.description: Each night, jail one player: they are protected from kills and cannot act.

roles.name: Janitor
roles.description: When the Mafia kills someone you choose to clean, their role is hidden from everyone but you.

roles.name: Jester
roles.description: Third party. You win if you get yourself lynched.

roles.name: Jester Scum
roles.description: You are Mafia, but you appear as a Jester if investigated or revealed.

roles.name: John Doe
roles.description: Your identity is hidden: when you die, your role isn't revealed.

roles.name: Joker
roles.description: Each night, swap abilities with a player.

roles.name: Journalist
roles.description: Once per game, publish a story: post a message through the host to everyone.

roles.name: Judas
roles.description: You are Town, but if lynched, you become Mafia.

roles.name: Judge
roles.description: Once per game, during the day, you may sentence a player to death.

roles.name: Judicator
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. They cannot be lynched the next day and cannot act tonight.

roles.name: Keymaker
roles.description: Each night, give a player a key: they can escape one attack or jail.

roles.name: Kidnapper
roles.description: Each night, kidnap a player: you talk privately, and they cannot act.

roles.name: Killjoy
roles.description: Each night, remove a player's extra abilities or items.

roles.name: King
roles.description: Your vote decides ties, or counts extra, as the host describes.

roles.name: Kingmaker
roles.description: Once per game, choose a player to become King (extra vote power).

roles.name: Late Townie
roles.description: You are told your role late: you receive your role PM after the first day or night.

roles.name: Lawyer
roles.description: Each night, pick a player; they appear innocent to investigations that night.

roles.name: Lazy Vigilante
roles.description: You may kill a player, but only every other night.

roles.name: Leader
roles.description: While you are alive, your faction's actions get a bonus, as the host describes.

roles.name: Legal Archivist
roles.description: Each night, look up a player's past actions or votes.

roles.name: Leprechaun
roles.description: Each night, move a player's action to a random target.

roles.name: Lie Detector
roles.description: Each day, check whether a player's claim is true.

roles.name: Lightning Rod
roles.description: All kills on a chosen player are moved to you.

roles.name: Little Girl
roles.description: You can peek at the Mafia's chat at night, but risk being caught.

roles.name: Loner
roles.description: You win if you survive and none of your teammates do.

roles.name: Lost Mason
roles.description: You are a Mason but don't know the other Masons.

roles.name: Lottery Winner
roles.description: At some point in the game, you receive a random power.

roles.name: Loudmouth
roles.description: When you are targeted at night, everyone learns who targeted you.

roles.name: Loved
roles.description: It takes one more vote than normal to lynch you.

roles.name: Lover
roles.description: You are linked to another player. If one Lover dies, the other dies too.

roles.name: Lumberjack
roles.description: Each night, chop at a player's role: they lose part of their ability.

roles.name: Lycan
roles.description: You are a werewolf who doesn't know it: you appear as a Werewolf to investigations.

roles.name: Elimination Bait
roles.description: If you are lynched, someone else dies too (the host decides who, or a random voter).

roles.name: Eliminated
roles.description: You are linked to a mission: you win if a specific player is lynched.

roles.name: Executioner BA
roles.description: Third party. You are given a target; you win if they are lynched.

roles.name: Lynchproof
roles.description: You cannot be lynched; if you are, you survive.

roles.name: Macho Cop
roles.description: You investigate alignment each night, but you cannot be protected.

roles.name: Mad Gunman
roles.description: You have a gun that fires at random players.

roles.name: Mad Scientist
roles.description: Each night, experiment on a player: their role changes in a random way.

roles.name: Mafia Goon
roles.description: No ability beyond the Mafia's shared night kill and private chat.

roles.name: Magistrate
roles.description: You can cancel a lynch once per game.

roles.name: Magnet
roles.description: All actions aimed at players near a chosen player go to them.

roles.name: Martyr
roles.description: Sacrifice yourself to save another player.

roles.name: Mason
roles.description: You know the other Masons and share a private chat. All Masons are confirmed Town to each other.

roles.name: Mason Finder
roles.description: Each night, check a player to see if they are a Mason.

roles.name: Masonizer
roles.description: Each night, make a player a Mason; they join your private chat.

roles.name: Mass Murderer
roles.description: Third party. Visit a house at night and kill everyone there.

roles.name: Match Finder
roles.description: Each night, check two players: you learn whether they are on the same side.

roles.name: Mediator
roles.description: You have a few abilities that help settle disputes: protecting, blocking, or swapping.

roles.name: Medicine Man
roles.description: You think you're a Doctor, but your treatment has random effects.

roles.name: Medium
roles.description: You can speak with the dead at night.

roles.name: Megaman
roles.description: Each time you kill someone, you gain their ability.

roles.name: Mentalist
roles.description: Each night, choose two players and learn whether they are on the same side.

roles.name: Messenger
roles.description: Each night, deliver a message from one player to another.

roles.name: Methodical Cop
roles.description: You investigate a player over several nights; the result comes when you finish.

roles.name: Miller
roles.description: An innocent Townie who appears guilty to alignment investigations.

roles.name: Millionaire
roles.description: You have money: you can buy items or votes from the host.

roles.name: Mime
roles.description: Third party. You may not speak; you win if you survive.

roles.name: Mimic
roles.description: Each night, choose a player and copy their role.

roles.name: Mind Controller
roles.description: Each night, take control of a player: you choose their target.

roles.name: Mirror
roles.description: Actions aimed at you are reflected back at the player who sent them.

roles.name: Mirror Maker
roles.description: Each night, give a player a mirror: the next action on them is reflected.

roles.name: Mistletoe
roles.description: Third party. Choose two players to kiss; you win if they survive together.

roles.name: Modifier
roles.description: Each night, add a modifier (e.g. Bulletproof, Ninja) to a player.

roles.name: Modposter
roles.description: You can post one message per game as if you were the host.

roles.name: Monitor
roles.description: Each night, learn how many players visited a chosen player.

roles.name: Monk
roles.description: Third party. You protect players at night; you win if you survive.

roles.name: Moon Wolf
roles.description: Third party. You kill at night on full-moon nights only.

roles.name: Morpher
roles.description: Each night, take on the appearance of another role.

roles.name: Mortician
roles.description: Each night, learn the role of a dead player, even if it was hidden.

roles.name: Motion Detector
roles.description: Each night, learn whether a player moved (performed an action).

roles.name: Motivator
roles.description: Each night, motivate a player: their action can't be blocked.

roles.name: Mugger
roles.description: Each night, steal a player's ability for yourself for one night.

roles.name: Multi Doctor
roles.description: Each night, protect more than one player.

roles.name: Muse
roles.description: While you are alive, a chosen player's ability is stronger.

roles.name: Mute
roles.description: You cannot vote.

roles.name: Mystic
roles.description: Each night, learn whether a player is a power role.

roles.name: Naive Cop
roles.description: Investigates alignment, but every result comes back innocent. You are not told this.

roles.name: Naive Doctor
roles.description: You protect a player each night, but you are told every protection succeeded whether or not it did.

roles.name: Neapolitan
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn whether they are a Vanilla Townie.

roles.name: Necromancer
roles.description: Each night, raise a dead player to use their ability once.

roles.name: Neighbor
roles.description: You share a private chat with one or more other players.

roles.name: Neighborhood Watchman
roles.description: You share a chat with other watchmen and learn who visits the players you watch.

roles.name: Neighborizer
roles.description: Each night, add a player to your private chat.

roles.name: Neutralizer
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player; if they are a third party, they die.

roles.name: Nexus
roles.description: Actions aimed at you are redirected to a random player.

roles.name: Ninja
roles.description: Trackers and Watchers do not see your visits.

roles.name: Ninja Baker
roles.description: You hand out bread without being seen by Trackers or Watchers.

roles.name: Normalizer
roles.description: Each night, turn a player into a vanilla role of their alignment.

roles.name: Nurse
roles.description: You become a Doctor if the Doctor dies.

roles.name: Nymphomaniac
roles.description: Each night, visit a player: you share a private chat with them that night.

roles.name: Observer
roles.description: Each night, learn the role of a player who acted on a target you choose.

roles.name: Old Man
roles.description: You have no ability; you may die of old age on a set night.

roles.name: Oracle
roles.description: Choose a player each night; if you die, their role or alignment is revealed.

roles.name: Pacifist
roles.description: While you are alive, no one can be killed at night on a set night, as the host describes.

roles.name: Paparazzi
roles.description: Each night, follow a player and learn everyone they interacted with.

roles.name: Paralyzer
roles.description: Once per game, paralyze voting: no lynch can happen that day.

roles.name: Paranoid Bat Owner
roles.description: Anyone who visits you at night is roleblocked.

roles.name: Paranoid Cop
roles.description: Investigates alignment, but every result comes back guilty. You are not told this.

roles.name: Paranoid Doctor
roles.description: You protect a player each night, but you may block them instead.

roles.name: Paranoid Gun Owner
roles.description: You kill anyone who visits you at night.

roles.name: Parasite
roles.description: Attach yourself to a player; you appear as their role to investigations.

roles.name: Parity Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player. You learn whether they share an alignment with the player you checked the night before.

roles.name: Parrot
roles.description: Each night, copy the last ability used on you.

roles.name: Party Host
roles.description: Once per game, throw a party: chosen players share a private chat that night.

roles.name: Pathologist
roles.description: Each night, examine a dead player and learn their role and who visited them.

roles.name: Peeping Tom
roles.description: Each night, watch a player and learn who visited them.

roles.name: Penguin
roles.description: Each night, learn whether a player is cold-blooded (killing role) or not.

roles.name: Personal Bodyguard
roles.description: You guard one specific player for the whole game; you die in their place if they're attacked.

roles.name: Pirate Baker
roles.description: You hand out bread that also roleblocks the receiver.

roles.name: Points Sacrificer
roles.description: You have points to spend on abilities; spending them uses up your power.

roles.name: Poisoner
roles.description: Each night, poison a player. They die at the end of the next day unless cured.

roles.name: Police Commissioner
roles.description: You receive copies of investigation results from Cops.

roles.name: Politician
roles.description: Third party. You win if you are alive and have a lot of votes when the game ends.

roles.name: Pollster
roles.description: Each night, learn how many players would vote for a given player.

roles.name: Pope
roles.description: Once per game, protect everyone from conversion that night.

roles.name: Possessor
roles.description: Each night, possess a player and use their ability.

roles.name: President
roles.description: You are a key Town figure. If you die, the Town loses (or something bad happens, as the host describes).

roles.name: Pretender
roles.description: You pretend to have a role and gain its abilities over time.

roles.name: Priest
roles.description: Each night, protect a player from conversion or recruitment.

roles.name: Princess
roles.description: While you are alive, a chosen faction is protected in some way.

roles.name: Private Investigator
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player and learn their role and alignment.

roles.name: Probate Lawyer
roles.description: When a player dies, you inherit their items.

roles.name: Prober
roles.description: Each night, probe a player: you learn their action and block it.

roles.name: Producer
roles.description: Each night, learn the number of players who acted that night.

roles.name: Prophet
roles.description: Third party. Predict an event; you win if it happens.

roles.name: Protector
roles.description: Each night, protect a player from a non-killing action.

roles.name: Proxy
roles.description: You are linked to another player and receive their results.

roles.name: Pseudojester
roles.description: Third party. You win if lynched, but you can change sides if a condition is met.

roles.name: Psychiatrist
roles.description: Each night, treat a player: you cure them of insanity or other effects.

roles.name: Psychic
roles.description: You receive visions: the host tells you information about a random player each night.

roles.name: Psychopath
roles.description: A killer who must kill every night.

roles.name: Psychotrooper
roles.description: Third party. You appear as a random role and may affect everyone at once.

roles.name: Puppet Master
roles.description: Each night, control two players: one targets the other.

roles.name: Purple Goo
roles.description: When a player targets you, they become Purple Goo and lose their ability.

roles.name: Rabble Rouser
roles.description: Once per game, start a riot: the day's lynch is decided by random vote.

roles.name: Radiant
roles.description: Anyone who targets you is redirected to themselves.

roles.name: Random Cop
roles.description: You investigate alignment, but some results are random.

roles.name: Randomizer
roles.description: Each night, choose a player: their action goes to a random target.

roles.name: Ranger
roles.description: You have several abilities and may use one each night.

roles.name: Recharger
roles.description: Each night, recharge a player's used ability.

roles.name: Recruiting Mason
roles.description: Each night, recruit a player into the Masons.

roles.name: Red Goo
roles.description: Players who target you are added to a private chat with you.

roles.name: Redirector
roles.description: Each night, pick a player and a new target; that player's action is redirected to the new target.

roles.name: Reflector
roles.description: Actions targeting you bounce back to the player who sent them.

roles.name: Reflexive Doctor
roles.description: You automatically protect anyone who targets you.

roles.name: Replicator
roles.description: When you visit a player, you copy their role and appear as it.

roles.name: Reporter
roles.description: Each night, learn what action a player took.

roles.name: Restless Spirit
roles.description: After you die, you can still vote.

roles.name: Retired Marine
roles.description: You are bulletproof and appear as a Vanilla Townie.

roles.name: Retired Werewolf Hunter
roles.description: If a werewolf attacks you, you survive and it dies.

roles.name: Revealer
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. Their role is revealed publicly at the start of the next day.

roles.name: Riddler
roles.description: Third party. Each night, give a player a riddle; if they fail it, they die.

roles.name: Ritualist
roles.description: Each night, perform a ritual to gain a power or help your faction.

roles.name: Rogue
roles.description: Each night, steal a player's role information and gain power.

roles.name: Role Cop
roles.description: Each night, investigate one player and learn their role (and any modifiers).

roles.name: Role Oracle
roles.description: Choose a player each night; if you die, their role is revealed publicly.

roles.name: Role Reverser
roles.description: Each night, reverse a player's ability (protect becomes kill, etc.).

roles.name: Role Swapper
roles.description: Each night, swap the roles of two players.

roles.name: Role Thief
roles.description: Each night, steal a player's role and learn it.

roles.name: Roleblocker
roles.description: Each night, block one player from performing their night action.

roles.name: Roleblocker Bodyguard
roles.description: Each night, guard a player; you block anyone who targets them.

roles.name: Rolestopper
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. All actions targeting them fail.

roles.name: Saboteur
roles.description: Each night, sabotage a player: their action fails and may harm them.

roles.name: Saint
roles.description: If you are lynched, someone who voted for you dies.

roles.name: Santa
roles.description: Each night, give a player a gift (an item or extra ability).

roles.name: Sasquatch
roles.description: You can't be seen: investigations on you fail.

roles.name: Saulus
roles.description: You start on one side and switch to the other after a set event.

roles.name: Savior
roles.description: If a chosen player would die, you may die in their place and change sides.

roles.name: Scapegoat
roles.description: If the day ends in a tie, you are lynched.

roles.name: Scavenger
roles.description: Each night, search a dead player's body for items or abilities.

roles.name: Schizophrenic
roles.description: Each night, your target is chosen at random from your choices.

roles.name: Scrambler
roles.description: Each night, scramble a player: investigations on them return random results.

roles.name: Secret Service Agent
roles.description: You protect the President; if they are attacked, you may kill the attacker.

roles.name: Secretary
roles.description: Each night, see the actions sent to the host by a chosen player.

roles.name: Security Man
roles.description: Each night, learn who visited a chosen player and block them.

roles.name: Seer
roles.description: Each night, investigate one player and learn their alignment.

roles.name: Senator
roles.description: Your vote counts extra, and you can veto a lynch once.

roles.name: Sensei
roles.description: Each night, train a player: they become immune to a block or gain an extra use.

roles.name: Sensor
roles.description: Each night, sense whether a player is a power role.

roles.name: Seraph Knight
roles.description: You protect a player each night and kill the first attacker.

roles.name: Serial Killer
roles.description: A lone killer. Kill one player each night. You win when you are the last one standing.

roles.name: Shaman
roles.description: Each night, use a ritual to help a player.

roles.name: Shapeshifter
roles.description: Each night, take a player's appearance: you appear as their role if investigated or killed.

roles.name: Sheriff
roles.description: Each night, investigate a player; if they are scum, you may shoot them.

roles.name: Shrink
roles.description: Each night, treat a player: you cure them of insanity or convert them back.

roles.name: Silencer
roles.description: Each night, silence one player; they may not post during the next day.

roles.name: Silversmith
roles.description: Each night, give a player silver: they become deadly to werewolves.

roles.name: Siren
roles.description: Third party. Each night, lure a player to you; if they visit you, they die.

roles.name: Slave
roles.description: You serve a Slave Master and win with them.

roles.name: Slave Master
roles.description: You command a Slave and win with them.

roles.name: Sleepwalker
roles.description: You visit a random player each night without knowing it.

roles.name: Sleuth
roles.description: Each night, investigate a dead player and learn their role and killer.

roles.name: Snoop
roles.description: Each night, check a player's items.

roles.name: Sorcerer
roles.description: Each night, learn a player's role. You work for the Mafia or a third party.

roles.name: Soul Linker
roles.description: Link two players: if one dies, so does the other.

roles.name: Soul Stealer
roles.description: Each night, steal a player's soul: they lose their ability permanently.

roles.name: Spartacus
roles.description: Others may claim to be you; if anyone claims your role, everyone who did dies.

roles.name: Sponge
roles.description: Each night, choose a player. You absorb all actions aimed at them.

roles.name: Squasher
roles.description: Each night, squash a player's ability: their action fails.

roles.name: Stalker
roles.description: Each night, follow a player and learn where they went.

roles.name: Steadfast Townie
roles.description: You cannot be converted, blocked or redirected.

roles.name: Strongman
roles.description: Your kill cannot be stopped by protection.

roles.name: Subscriber
roles.description: You receive regular updates from the host about the game.

roles.name: Suicide Bomber
roles.description: Once, kill a target and yourself.

roles.name: Super Backup
roles.description: When any power role dies, you may inherit it.

roles.name: Super Commandant
roles.description: You can investigate and protect, depending on the night.

roles.name: Super Godfather
roles.description: A Godfather variant; immune to investigation and with an extra immunity.

roles.name: Super Saint
roles.description: If you are lynched, the player whose vote lynched you dies.

roles.name: Surgeon
roles.description: Each night, protect a player and change their role reveal if they die.

roles.name: Survivalist
roles.description: You can protect yourself or kill an attacker.

roles.name: Survivor
roles.description: Third party. You win if you are alive at the end of the game.

roles.name: Switch
roles.description: Each night, switch two players' roles or actions.

roles.name: Tactician
roles.description: Each night, plan your team's actions: they get a bonus.

roles.name: Tailor
roles.description: Each night, change what role a player is revealed as if they die.

roles.name: Taxi Driver
roles.description: Each night, swap two players: all actions on one go to the other.

roles.name: Tentacled Townie
roles.description: You are Town but appear as an alien or monster to investigations.

roles.name: Therapist
roles.description: Each night, treat a player: you learn their role and cure them.

roles.name: Thug
roles.description: Your vote can't be changed once cast.

roles.name: Time Bandit
roles.description: Each night, steal time from a player: their action happens a night later.

roles.name: Time Freezer
roles.description: Once per game, freeze time: no actions resolve that night.

roles.name: Time Killer
roles.description: Kill a player at a set time (they die later).

roles.name: Time Mage
roles.description: Each night, change when a player's action resolves.

roles.name: Time Protector
roles.description: Each night, protect a player for the next night as well.

roles.name: Time Traveller
roles.description: Each night, learn what happened on a past night.

roles.name: Tinkerer
roles.description: Each night, build a trap or gadget that can kill.

roles.name: Tooth Fairy
roles.description: Each night, visit a player: you learn a fact about them.

roles.name: Torturer
roles.description: Each night, torture a player: they are blocked and you learn their role.

roles.name: Town Drunk
roles.description: You must post in a certain way (e.g. slurred) to keep your power.

roles.name: Toxic Goo
roles.description: Anyone who targets you dies.

roles.name: Tracker
roles.description: Each night, follow one player and learn who they visited.

roles.name: Traffic Controller
roles.description: Each night, redirect actions between players.

roles.name: Traitor
roles.description: A Town-appearing player who wins with the Mafia but doesn't know who they are.

roles.name: Traitor Finder
roles.description: Each night, learn whether a player is a Traitor.

roles.name: Trapper
roles.description: Each night, set a trap at a player's house; the first visitor dies.

roles.name: Tree Stump
roles.description: You are a tree stump: you cannot vote or act, but you can still post.

roles.name: Triplevoter
roles.description: Your vote counts three times.

roles.name: Turncoat
roles.description: At some point, you may change sides.

roles.name: Undercover Cop
roles.description: You are Town, placed in the Mafia: you appear as Mafia to them and learn their plans.

roles.name: Underdog
roles.description: Third party. You gain power as your side loses players.

roles.name: Universal Backup
roles.description: When a power role dies, you may inherit it.

roles.name: Universal Miller
roles.description: You appear guilty to every kind of investigation.

roles.name: Unlyncher
roles.description: Third party. Once per game, cancel a lynch; you win if you survive.

roles.name: Usurper
roles.description: You win if you take the place of your faction's leader.

roles.name: Vampire Lord
roles.description: Third party. Each night, bite a player to turn them into a vampire.

roles.name: Vanilla Cop
roles.description: Each night, learn whether a player is a vanilla (no-ability) role.

roles.name: Vanilla Townie
roles.description: No special ability. Find and lynch the threats to the Town.

roles.name: Vanillaizer
roles.description: Each night, make a player vanilla: they lose their ability.

roles.name: Vengeful Sibling
roles.description: If your sibling dies, you seek revenge on their killer.

roles.name: Ventriloquist
roles.description: Each night, make a player post or vote as you choose the next day.

roles.name: Victim
roles.description: Kills aimed at a chosen player go to you instead.

roles.name: Vigilante
roles.description: Each night, you may kill one player.

roles.name: VIP
roles.description: If you are killed, your killer dies too.

roles.name: Virgin
roles.description: If you are lynched, the Mafia cannot kill the following night.

roles.name: Virus
roles.description: Third party. Each night, infect a player; infected players die over time.

roles.name: Voodoo Lady
roles.description: Choose a player and a word; if they say the word, they die.

roles.name: Voodooist
roles.description: Third party. Curse players; you win if they die.

roles.name: Vote Cop
roles.description: Each night, learn who a player voted for.

roles.name: Vote Manipulator
roles.description: Each night, change a player's vote the next day.

roles.name: Votebuyer
roles.description: Each night, buy a player's vote for the next day.

roles.name: Voyeur
roles.description: Each night, watch a player and learn what kinds of actions were used on them.

roles.name: Voyeur Guesser
roles.description: Each night, guess what actions were used on a player.

roles.name: Warlock
roles.description: Third party. Curse a player; you win if your curse is fulfilled.

roles.name: Watcher
roles.description: Each night, watch one player and learn who visited them.

roles.name: Watchlisted Townie
roles.description: You are Town but appear suspicious to investigations.

roles.name: Weak Doctor
roles.description: Protects one player from night kills, but there is a chance the save fails.

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.description: Member of the Werewolf faction; kills at night with the pack.

roles.name: White Mage
roles.description: Each night, heal a player of an effect or protect them.

roles.name: Wildcard
roles.description: Each night, you get a random ability.

roles.name: Wish Granter
roles.description: Once per game, grant a player a wish (an ability or item).

roles.name: Witch
roles.description: Each night, control a player: you choose their target.

roles.name: Witness
roles.description: Each night, see who visited a player and what they did.

roles.name: Wizard
roles.description: You have several magical abilities and choose one each night.

roles.name: Yakuza
roles.description: Once per game, sacrifice yourself to convert a player to the Mafia.

roles.name: Yellow Goo
roles.description: When a player targets you, they become Yellow Goo and lose their ability.

roles.name: Zombie
roles.description: Third party. Each night, infect a player; infected players become zombies.

modifiers.name: Bulletproof
modifiers.description: Survives night kills.

modifiers.name: Ninja
modifiers.description: Visits are invisible to Trackers and Watchers.

modifiers.name: Strongman
modifiers.description: Kills ignore protection.

modifiers.name: Macho
modifiers.description: Cannot be protected by Doctors or Bodyguards.

modifiers.name: Detection Immune
modifiers.description: Appears innocent to alignment checks.

modifiers.name: Suspicious
modifiers.description: Appears guilty to alignment checks.

modifiers.name: Roleblock Immune
modifiers.description: Cannot be roleblocked or jailed into inaction.

modifiers.name: Lynchproof
modifiers.description: Survives being lynched.

modifiers.name: Hated
modifiers.description: Needs one fewer vote to lynch.

modifiers.name: Loved
modifiers.description: Needs one more vote to lynch.

modifiers.name: 1-Shot
modifiers.description: Ability can be used once per game.

modifiers.name: 2-Shot
modifiers.description: Ability can be used twice per game.

modifiers.name: 3-Shot
modifiers.description: Ability can be used three times per game.

modifiers.name: Odd Night
modifiers.description: May only act on odd-numbered nights.

modifiers.name: Even Night
modifiers.description: May only act on even-numbered nights.

modifiers.name: Non-consecutive
modifiers.description: Cannot target the same player two nights in a row.

modifiers.name: Self-targetable
modifiers.description: May target themself.

modifiers.name: Loyal
modifiers.description: Cannot target members of their own faction.

modifiers.name: Day Action
modifiers.description: Uses the ability during the day (host resolves).

modifiers.name: Compulsive
modifiers.description: Must use the ability every night.
